ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1814601505000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.
